name: Prosus N.V.
note: Dutch-listed consumer-internet group (Euronext Amsterdam: PRX), formed to house Naspers's international internet assets. Naspers is its majority owner (prosus.com, Group structure); Naspers's annual financial statements 2026 give the Naspers group's effective interest in Prosus as 43.4% at 31 March 2026, after the cross-holding was removed in September 2023.
